column4: Republic Act No. 9211 (Tobacco Regulation Act of 2003)
column6: Section 5. Smoking in Public Places. — Smoking shall be absolutely prohibited in the following public places: (a) Centers of youth activity such as playschools, elementary schools, high schools, colleges and universities, youth hostels and recreational facilities for persons under eighteen (18) years old; (b) Elevators and stairwells; (c) Locations in which fire hazards are present, including gas stations and storage areas for flammable materials; (d) Within the buildings and premises of public and private hospitals, medical, dental, and optical clinics, health centers, nursing homes, dispensaries and laboratories; and (e) Public conveyances and public facilities.
column7: City Ordinance No. 0367-18, Series of 2018 (The Comprehensive Davao City Smoke-Free Public Environments and Tobacco Regulation Code)
column9: SECTION 6. DESIGNATED OUTDOOR SMOKING AREAS. — Pursuant to the local health autonomy mandate under Republic Act No. 7160 and in pursuit of the Universal Health Care framework, designated smoking areas in commercial complexes shall be situated strictly in open outdoor spaces, positioned at least ten (10) meters away from building entrances, operable windows, and public access pathways. The City Health Office (CHO) and the City Epidemiological Surveillance Unit shall deploy health sanitary inspectors to ensure strict protocol enforcement.
column10: City Ordinance No. 0367-18, Series of 2018 (The Comprehensive Davao City Smoke-Free Public Environments and Tobacco Regulation Code)
